prompt:
Compose an email asking a former teammate whether they would be comfortable sharing a few practical tips with a newcomer to the group. A response of around 120 words is enough.

Write the requested response as one self-contained paragraph of plain text. Do not use a title, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, Markdown formatting, code fences, or line breaks. Include only the requested content, without any introductory or closing commentary from the assistant. Keep the approximate word target given in the task. If the task calls for an email, dialogue, steps, or calculations, express that content within the same paragraph.
base_prompt: Compose an email asking a former teammate whether they would be comfortable sharing a few practical tips with a newcomer to the group. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text: Subject: Quick Advice for a New Teammate Hi [Name], I hope you’ve been well! We have someone new joining the group who is getting familiar with how we work, and I immediately thought of the practical perspective you developed while you were here. Would you feel comfortable sharing a few tips that might help them get started—for example, useful routines, common pitfalls to avoid, or ways to work effectively with the team? There’s no need for anything formal or time-consuming; even a short note with a few observations would be greatly appreciated. Of course, please don’t feel any pressure if your schedule is busy. Thanks for considering it, and I hope everything is going well for you. Best, [Your Name]
